requests.name: ant
requests.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: realistic miniature collection icon for a purple chart. Reference image is the old icon: retain recognizable material and species/product identity, but replace its camera angle with a STRICT TOP/DORSAL VIEW, looking straight down at the specimen's back, as though its underside is glued to a vertical museum display wall and we face that wall. Main outline lies parallel to image plane, no isometric or corner view, no perspective foreshortening. Clean high-quality detailed photoreal miniature, crisp silhouette readable at 128px. Lighting soft strong upper-left/front, clearly shaded lower-right relief, very subtle violet ambient fill. One centered object filling about 92-94% of longest canvas dimension with clear margin on every side. Square transparent PNG, REAL alpha background, NO cast shadow, NO wall, shelf, ground, pins, glue, text or watermark. Only natural self-shading. A single reddish chestnut ant, HEAD POINTING UP, elongated abdomen below. Anatomically accurate dorsal specimen, three clear body regions, narrow waist, two elbowed antennae reaching upward, exactly six articulated legs in three pairs attached to thorax, sensibly spread sideways. Fine exoskeleton texture and restrained amber specular highlights. Entire legs and antennae in frame.
